scripts.dev: bun run --cwd backend/server dev & bun run --cwd backend/background-worker dev & bun run --cwd frontend dev & wait
scripts.build: bun run --cwd backend build && bun run --cwd frontend build
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:backend && bun run typecheck:frontend
scripts.typecheck:backend: bun run --cwd backend/shared build && cd backend/server && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
